title: Crunchyroll Shatters New Record (But There’s a Catch)
content: Anime’s rise in popularity is only growing with each passing year, as the medium seemingly isn’t slowing down any time soon. One of the biggest North American studios that has been able to capitalize on the uptick is Sony Pictures, which just so happens to own the anime streaming service Crunchyroll .
author: ComicBook

title: Korea Fair Trade Commission Launches Probe into Webtoon, Web Novel Industry Practices
content: The Korea Fair Trade Commission (KFTC) has launched a full-scale investigation into the revenue structures and business practices of the webtoon and web novel industry, aiming to address long-standing concerns over unfair contracts and profit distribution.
author: ANN

title: The Simpsons: A Classic Villain Was Almost Voiced by Hollywood Royalty
content: While The Simpsons is definitely a comedy, this doesn’t mean that Homer and his family haven’t had to take on some truly diabolical villains in their time. Mr. Burns, the head of Springfield’s Nuclear Powerplant, has long been a thorn in the family’s side, while throwing some terrifying challenges at the town.

title: New Live-Action GTO: Great Teacher Onizuka Series Casts Meru Nukumi
content: Kansai TV announced on Saturday that the new live-action series based on Tohru Fujisawa 's GTO: Great Teacher Onizuka manga has cast Meru Nukumi ( My Hero Academia: You're Next 's Anna Scervino, live-action Sexy Tanaka-san 's Akari Kurahashi).
author: ANN

title: Viz, MLB Players, Acky Bright's BW NYC Studios to Launch GalaXic Baseball League Comic Series
content: Viz announced on Friday that it is collaborating with MLB Players, Inc., OneTeam Partners, and the BW NYC Studios of Japanese artist Acky Bright for the science fiction series GalaXic Baseball League . The series will launch exclusively on the Viz Manga app on July 2, with the first print volume shipping on October.
author: ANN

title: Tatsuo Satou, Director of 'Kidou Senkan Nadesico' and 'Madan no Ou to Vanadis', Dies at 61
content: Tatsuo Satou , the acclaimed director and screenwriter behind Kidou Senkan Nadesico ( Martian Successor Nadesico ) and Madan no Ou to Vanadis ( Lord Marksman and Vanadis ), died on April 24 due to liver failure. He was 61.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Kagurabachi Studio’s Stunning Summer 2026 Anime Confirms Release Date With New Trailer
content: 2026 is going to be yet another exciting year for anime fans, with several thrilling series returning with their sequels on top of major debuts. January is almost over, and the first month of the year has already proved it.

title: Crunchyroll’s Major Series Creator Unveils New Look At Beloved Character Ahead of Anime Sequel
content: Kusanagi Mizuho’s beloved fantasy shojo manga, Yona of the Dawn , reached its conclusion on December 19th, 2025, after a 16-year-long journey. The historical manga debuted in 2009 on a monthly schedule, earning praise for its gorgeous art, unique storytelling, and lovable characters.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Is All Set For Its Anticipated Final Release
content: The hit Jujutsu Kaisen manga, written and illustrated by Gege Akutami, ended serialization in September 2024. It wasn’t until December 25th of the same year that Shueisha released Volumes 29 and 30, marking the end of the incredible story.
author: ComicBook
